items.title: OpenRouter's staggering token chart is the AI bubble debate in a single image
items.summary: On OpenRouter, weekly token consumption has surged more than 25,000 percent since January 2025, from 0.5 to 126.2 trillion tokens. The number looks impressive, but it says less about actual AI usage than about token-hungry reasoning models and a growing number of unoptimized AI agents that burn through tokens at staggering rates. The article OpenRouter's staggering token chart is the AI bubble debate in a single image appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 在 OpenRouter 上，每週的 Token 消耗量自 2025 年 1 月以來已飆升超過 25,000%，從 0.5 兆躍升至 126.2 兆個 Token。這個數字看起來相當驚人，但它比起實際的 AI 使用情況，更能反映出消耗大量 Token 的推論模型，以及數量不斷增加、以驚人速度消耗 Token 卻未經優化的 AI 代理。這篇題為〈OpenRouter 驚人的 Token 圖表是 AI 泡沫爭辯的單一縮影〉的文章首先發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra decrypts a Nazi radio message in ten hours that went unsolved for 83 years
items.summary: A Bloomberg developer claims to have cracked an 83-year-old Enigma message from the Wehrmacht using OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra. The 82-character radio message from 1941 contains a soldier asking about his march route. The solution still needs independent review. The article OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra decrypts a Nazi radio message in ten hours that went unsolved for 83 years appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 一名彭博社（Bloomberg）開發人員聲稱使用 OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra 破解了一則來自德意志國防軍（Wehrmacht）有 83 年歷史的恩尼格瑪（Enigma）密碼訊息。這則來自 1941 年、共 82 個字元的無線電訊息內容是一名士兵詢問他的行軍路線。該解法仍需獨立審查。〈OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra 用十小時解密了懸未決 83 年的納粹無線電訊息〉一文最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: 英特爾佈局邊緣AI生態系，從零售、製造到交通推動Physical AI落地
items.summary: AI發展正在從大型模型訓練階段，逐漸轉向如何讓模型真正進入產業場景。英特爾邊緣運算事業群生態系發展部門總經理杜唯揚表示，過去邊緣運算歷經嵌入式運算、物聯網（IoT）到電腦視覺（Computer Vision）等階段，現在隨著生成式AI、Agentic AI與Physical AI興起，邊緣端將成為AI實際應用的重要環節。 杜唯揚指出，市場目前並不缺少AI模型，許多企業面臨的是「如何選擇模型，以及如何將模型部署到實際環境」的問題。因此，邊緣AI未來需要的不只是運算能力，而是完整支援感知（Sense）、推理（Reasoning）與行動（Acting）的平臺。

items.title: Apple is reportedly building an enterprise AI server with its own M8 Ultra chips
items.summary: According to The Information, Apple is working on an enterprise server with two or four M8 Ultra chips for the AI inference market, with a possible launch no earlier than 2029. items.title: Former OpenAI researcher builds an AI model that judges options instead of writing text
items.summary: TypeSafe AI, founded by former OpenAI researcher Diogo Almeida, is releasing a model that deliberately generates no text. Instead of chat responses, "Jev" delivers pure classifications for software, with response times starting at 70 milliseconds and extremely low token prices. The approach doesn't protect against mistakes, though. The system only guarantees that it will stick strictly to the preset options. The article Former OpenAI researcher builds an AI model that judges options instead of writing text appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 由前 OpenAI 研究員迪奧戈・阿爾梅達（Diogo Almeida）創立的 TypeSafe AI 正在發布一款刻意不產生任何文字的模型。與聊天回覆不同，「Jev」為軟體提供純粹的分類，回應時間從 70 毫秒起跳，且權杖（token）價格極低。不過，這種方法並不能防止錯誤。該系統僅保證會嚴格遵守預設選項。本文〈前 OpenAI 研究員打造出能評判選項而非編寫文字的 AI 模型〉（Former OpenAI researcher builds an AI model that judges options instead of writing text）最初發表於 The Decoder。

items.title: Political opposites unite in Washington to rein in AI
items.summary: From Bernie Sanders to Steve Bannon, political opposites in Washington are jointly demanding hard brakes on artificial intelligence. Sanders wants a construction freeze on data centers, while OpenAI is backing the FRONTIER Act and its mandatory outside safety audits for the first time. Despite Trump's skepticism, bipartisan pressure for binding AI rules keeps growing. The article Political opposites unite in Washington to rein in AI appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: 從伯尼·桑德斯（Bernie Sanders）到史蒂夫·班農（Steve Bannon），華盛頓特區的政治對立雙方正共同要求對人工智慧踩下急煞車。桑德斯希望凍結資料中心的建設，而 OpenAI 則首次支援《FRONTIER 法案》及其強制性的外部安全稽核。儘管川普持懷疑態度，但針對具約束力 AI 規則的跨黨派壓力仍持續增長。「華盛頓的政治對立雙方聯合起來控制 AI」一文首先發布於 The Decoder。

items.summary: 9月17日，小米MiMo團隊負責人羅福莉首次公開MiMo-V2.6強化學習訓練進展，並上線實時頁面全程直播RL階段。此舉標誌小米在物理世界與通用智能探索進入突破期，技術細節未來數週開源。該模型正開展大規模多任務智能體訓練。

items.title: Your startup’s next teammate might be an AI agent: Gusto, Insight Partners, and Leland explain what that changes at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
items.summary: This session will explore how early-stage companies are building teams where humans and AI agents work alongside each other — and how founders can do that without sacrificing speed, accountability, or culture. Learn more at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026. Register before September 25 to save up to $200.
items.summary_zh: 本場議程將探討早期階段的公司如何建立團隊，讓人類與 AI 代理協同工作，以及創辦人在不犧牲速度、當責性或企業文化的同時，該如何做到這一點。請至 TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 瞭解更多資訊。於 9 月 25 日前註冊最高可省下 200 美元。

items.title: 騰訊 ChatterFly 低調內測:桌面語音輸入不再只轉文字，開口直接出郵件、週報和開發提示詞
items.summary: 騰訊正內測AI原生語音/表達工具ChatterFly，或名“元寶輸入法”，現開放macOS和Windows桌面端（需內測碼），iOS與Android即將發佈。它不同於常規輸入法僅做語音轉文字，將AI表達輔助前置：按Fn鍵語音錄入，再按Fn或雙擊可下達“寫週報”“生成開發提示詞”等指令，首頁集成輸入功能。

items.title: Claude Cowork and chat are now one Claude
items.summary: Claude Cowork and chat are now one Claude In hopefully good news for anyone who, like me, was increasingly confused at Cowork v.s. Claude v.s. Claude Code: Starting today, Claude Cowork and chat are merging into one Claude. Bring a quick question, or hand over a report due at noon, and Claude takes it from there, even after you’ve closed your laptop. [...] This is rolling out to Pro and Max plans first, in the Claude app on web, desktop, and mobile over the coming weeks to existing and new users on these plans. I guess this means Claude is becoming a general agent in its own right. Echoes of OpenAI renaming their Codex desktop app to ChatGPT a few weeks ago. On the one hand, this saves me some work, in that I was planning to finally figure out the boundaries between Cowork and regular Claude and write a follow-up to my piece on Understanding ChatGPT Work . I have a hunch that figuring out what this actually means in terms of features and surfaces is still going to take quite a bit of work. Via Hacker News Tags: ai , generative-ai , llms , anthropic , claude , general-agents
items.summary_zh: Claude Cowork 與聊天功能現在合而為一 Claude 對於像我一樣，對 Cowork 與 Claude 以及 Claude Code 之間的區別感到越來越困惑的人來說，這或許是個好消息：從今天開始，Claude Cowork 與聊天功能將合併為一個 Claude。您可以提出一個簡單的問題，或交出一份中午前要交的報告，Claude 就會接手處理，甚至在您闔上筆記型電腦之後也是如此。[...] 這項功能將在未來幾週內率先推出給現有和新訂閱 Pro 與 Max 方案的使用者，適用於網頁版、桌面版和行動版的 Claude 應用程式。我想這意味著 Claude 正在發展成為一個名副其實的通用代理程式。這讓人聯想到幾週前 OpenAI 將其 Codex 桌面應用程式更名為 ChatGPT 的作法。一方面，這為我省了一些工作，因為我原本打算徹底弄清楚 Cowork 與一般 Claude 之間的界線，並為我關於理解 ChatGPT 工作的文章寫一篇後續報導。我有一種預感，要弄清楚這在功能和介面層面上到底代表什麼，仍然需要花費不少功夫。透過 Hacker News 標籤：ai, generative-ai, llms, anthropic, claude, general-agents

items_ai.title: OpenRouter's staggering token chart is the AI bubble debate in a single image
items_ai.summary: On OpenRouter, weekly token consumption has surged more than 25,000 percent since January 2025, from 0.5 to 126.2 trillion tokens. The number looks impressive, but it says less about actual AI usage than about token-hungry reasoning models and a growing number of unoptimized AI agents that burn through tokens at staggering rates. The article OpenRouter's staggering token chart is the AI bubble debate in a single image appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: 在 OpenRouter 上，每週的 Token 消耗量自 2025 年 1 月以來已飆升超過 25,000%，從 0.5 兆躍升至 126.2 兆個 Token。這個數字看起來相當驚人，但它比起實際的 AI 使用情況，更能反映出消耗大量 Token 的推論模型，以及數量不斷增加、以驚人速度消耗 Token 卻未經優化的 AI 代理。這篇題為〈OpenRouter 驚人的 Token 圖表是 AI 泡沫爭辯的單一縮影〉的文章首先發表於 The Decoder。

items_ai.summary: AI發展正在從大型模型訓練階段，逐漸轉向如何讓模型真正進入產業場景。英特爾邊緣運算事業群生態系發展部門總經理杜唯揚表示，過去邊緣運算歷經嵌入式運算、物聯網（IoT）到電腦視覺（Computer Vision）等階段，現在隨著生成式AI、Agentic AI與Physical AI興起，邊緣端將成為AI實際應用的重要環節。 杜唯揚指出，市場目前並不缺少AI模型，許多企業面臨的是「如何選擇模型，以及如何將模型部署到實際環境」的問題。因此，邊緣AI未來需要的不只是運算能力，而是完整支援感知（Sense）、推理（Reasoning）與行動（Acting）的平臺。

items_ai.title: Political opposites unite in Washington to rein in AI
items_ai.summary: From Bernie Sanders to Steve Bannon, political opposites in Washington are jointly demanding hard brakes on artificial intelligence. Sanders wants a construction freeze on data centers, while OpenAI is backing the FRONTIER Act and its mandatory outside safety audits for the first time. Despite Trump's skepticism, bipartisan pressure for binding AI rules keeps growing. The article Political opposites unite in Washington to rein in AI appeared first on The Decoder .
items_ai.summary_zh: 從伯尼·桑德斯（Bernie Sanders）到史蒂夫·班農（Steve Bannon），華盛頓特區的政治對立雙方正共同要求對人工智慧踩下急煞車。桑德斯希望凍結資料中心的建設，而 OpenAI 則首次支援《FRONTIER 法案》及其強制性的外部安全稽核。儘管川普持懷疑態度，但針對具約束力 AI 規則的跨黨派壓力仍持續增長。「華盛頓的政治對立雙方聯合起來控制 AI」一文首先發布於 The Decoder。

items_ai.title: Claude Cowork and chat are now one Claude
items_ai.summary: Claude Cowork and chat are now one Claude In hopefully good news for anyone who, like me, was increasingly confused at Cowork v.s. Claude v.s. Claude Code: Starting today, Claude Cowork and chat are merging into one Claude. Bring a quick question, or hand over a report due at noon, and Claude takes it from there, even after you’ve closed your laptop. [...] This is rolling out to Pro and Max plans first, in the Claude app on web, desktop, and mobile over the coming weeks to existing and new users on these plans. I guess this means Claude is becoming a general agent in its own right. Echoes of OpenAI renaming their Codex desktop app to ChatGPT a few weeks ago. On the one hand, this saves me some work, in that I was planning to finally figure out the boundaries between Cowork and regular Claude and write a follow-up to my piece on Understanding ChatGPT Work . I have a hunch that figuring out what this actually means in terms of features and surfaces is still going to take quite a bit of work. Via Hacker News Tags: ai , generative-ai , llms , anthropic , claude , general-agents
items_ai.summary_zh: Claude Cowork 與聊天功能現在合而為一 Claude 對於像我一樣，對 Cowork 與 Claude 以及 Claude Code 之間的區別感到越來越困惑的人來說，這或許是個好消息：從今天開始，Claude Cowork 與聊天功能將合併為一個 Claude。您可以提出一個簡單的問題，或交出一份中午前要交的報告，Claude 就會接手處理，甚至在您闔上筆記型電腦之後也是如此。[...] 這項功能將在未來幾週內率先推出給現有和新訂閱 Pro 與 Max 方案的使用者，適用於網頁版、桌面版和行動版的 Claude 應用程式。我想這意味著 Claude 正在發展成為一個名副其實的通用代理程式。這讓人聯想到幾週前 OpenAI 將其 Codex 桌面應用程式更名為 ChatGPT 的作法。一方面，這為我省了一些工作，因為我原本打算徹底弄清楚 Cowork 與一般 Claude 之間的界線，並為我關於理解 ChatGPT 工作的文章寫一篇後續報導。我有一種預感，要弄清楚這在功能和介面層面上到底代表什麼，仍然需要花費不少功夫。透過 Hacker News 標籤：ai, generative-ai, llms, anthropic, claude, general-agents
